{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Commitment to replicate Governor Bush's success on the national level.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to use Superfund resources to clean up places where people live and labor, rather than spend it on costly litigation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The approach of mandate, regulate, and litigate has sent potential developers away from brownfield neighborhoods.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The result of the approach of mandate, regulate, and litigate is no new businesses, no new jobs, and dirty and dangerous sites.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Governor Bush pledged to transform the failure of the old approach into an environmental win for those communities, as he did in Texas.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to endorse Governor Bush's agenda.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to promote market-based programs that are voluntary, flexible, comprehensive, and cost-effective wherever it is environmentally responsible to do so.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Endangered Species Act (ESA) is sometimes counter-productive toward its goal of protecting rare species, 75 percent of which are located on private land.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The ESA's punitive approach encourages landowners to remove habitat to avoid federal intervention.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The ESA's punitive approach serves as a disincentive for private landowners to restore habitat and become private stewards of wildlife.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Legislation needs incentive-based cooperation among federal, state, local, and tribal governments, and private citizens.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The result of incentive-based cooperation will be a more effective ESA that better protects wildlife diversity.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
